key_insight: DiscoveryRSI recursively improves scientific hypothesis generation by learning from evidence-grounded investigations and their documented research trajectories.
engineering_relevance: The framework connects multi-agent hypothesis search to executable investigation tasks and feedback-driven workflow refinement.
method: Evolve hypothesis trees with feasible tests, explicit decision criteria, and alternative explanations.
Compile selected investigations into executable Harbor tasks and attribute scientific assessments to documented contributions.
Replay research workflows to identify useful strategies and failures, then apply accepted improvements to new investigations.
evidence_signal: Across four life-science domains, automated hypothesis-quality scores rose from 4.86 to 5.39 after two self-improvement rounds; preliminary human review found 6.3% correspondence with post-cutoff research versus 2.5% for GPT-6 and 2.3% for Claude Opus 5.
watch_item: Human assessments are preliminary, and correspondence with published research does not establish experimental validity or generalization beyond the evaluated domains.
paper_title: DiscoveryRSI: Recursively Learning to Discover Valuable Hypotheses
